p: Wherefore hath the LORD smitten us: For it seems that this war was undertaken by Samuel's commandment.
dwelleth between the cherubims: For he used to appear to the Israelites between the cherubim over the ark of the covenant, Ex 25:17.
Woe unto us: Before we fought against men, and now God has come to fight against us.
wilderness: For in the Red Sea in the wilderness the Egyptians were destroyed, which was the last of all his plagues.
thirty thousand footmen: David alluding to this place in Ps 78:63 says they were consumed with fire: meaning they were suddenly destroyed.
rent: In token of sorrow and mourning.
trembled for the ark of God: Lest it should be taken by the enemy.
are dead: According as God had said before.
bowed herself and travailed: And positioned her body for her labour and delivery.
The glory is departed from Israel: She uttered her great sorrow by repeating her words.
